title: How to Obtain Bonafide / Study Certificate from Institution
requiredDocuments: Current Academic Year Admission Fee Receipt
Previous semester mark sheet or admission order (CET/COMEDK/Management)

steps.title: College Office Application
steps.description: Submit a requisition letter or portal request to the college academic administrative office with admission order and fee receipt.

steps.title: Verification by College Nodal Officer
steps.description: Administrative desk verifies registration number, course name, AISHE college code, and admission year.

steps.title: Principal Signature and Seal
steps.description: Obtain signed bonafide certificate on institution letterhead carrying official seal, AISHE code, and student photo.

validityPeriod: Valid for the current academic year (2026-27).

sourceRef.portal: National Scholarship Portal Institution Verification Manual
